title: Ivo and the Veil
author: Edmund Marchetti
blurb: Mirabel Quintana, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
